offerings.name: Willow Wreath
offerings.description: A willow wreath, sized large for the door or small for a shelf, from willow that grows in Alberta's ditches. Together we will bend and wind it into a simple, quietly beautiful ring.
offerings.note: Participants receive enough willow for four wreaths, 8 to 12 inches across. We weave three together and the fourth bundle goes home. Available 1 November to 31 March.

offerings.name: Moon and Star
offerings.alt: A woven willow moon and star
offerings.description: Long before clocks, willow and the moon and the stars were working companions, marking the turn of the seasons. In this quiet workshop we will weave a willow moon and a star of your own.
offerings.note: Can run as one workshop, or as two consecutive sessions with stars in the first and a larger moon in the second. Both together need five hours and cost $145.

offerings.name: Berry Boat
offerings.alt: A shallow woven willow berry boat
offerings.description: A boat of willow knows many voyages: into the brambles for berries, onto the table for crackers, a shelf for small treasures. Using a simple wooden jig you will weave a shallow tray of your own. All tools and materials provided.

offerings.name: Suet Bird Feeder
offerings.alt: A woven willow suet bird feeder
offerings.description: A suet feeder for the winter birds, woven from willow. It is a simple, useful first project and a gentle way to get to know how willow twists and turns. Together we will make one to hang outside.
offerings.note: Price includes two pieces of suet.

offerings.name: Tiny Trug
offerings.description: A tiny willow trug, made to cradle soft petals, fragrant herbs, and the small treasures that whisper up from the forest floor. Together we will shape one to carry home.

offerings.name: Cattail Berry Basket
offerings.alt: A berry basket woven from cattail leaves
offerings.description: Cattail has a soft rustle and a warm colour all its own. Over a wooden form you will weave a small berry basket: a checkerboard weave, pairing, waling, and a simple trac border to finish. A gentle first meeting with the plant.

offerings.name: Textured Willow Bowl
offerings.alt: A textured willow bowl woven in rope coil
offerings.description: A bowl with a deep, ropey texture, worked in the rope coil weave. You will lay a 3 x 3 slath base, raise a slight foot with a four-rod drop-down wale, then carry the rope coil up the sides to a rod border. Some weaving experience helps.

offerings.name: Berry Basket
offerings.alt: A small round willow berry basket
offerings.description: A small round willow basket, about six inches across, is a whole grammar of basketry in miniature. You will lay a slath base, then work waling, pairing, and slewing up the sides to a rod border. No experience necessary.

offerings.name: Large Round Willow Basket
offerings.alt: A large round willow basket with inset handles
offerings.description: Over two days, a generous round willow basket with inset handles. You will lay a 3 x 3 slath base, then pairing, waling, and French randing to a classic rod border, with time to really settle into the willow.
offerings.note: Two days gives the time to work deeply with willow, to find the rhythm of it, and to carry home a basket built to serve for years.

offerings.name: Large Twisted Willow Basket
offerings.alt: A large sculptural willow basket with a twisted rope effect
offerings.description: Worked with generous bundles of willow, this basket carries a striking twist, like rope laid round and round. You will lay a slath base, work pairing and waling, then the rope coil weave up to a rod border. Some experience recommended, keen beginners welcome.
offerings.note: Along the way: pairing, waling, and rod borders, with the option of a sturdy handle.
